Build passes now, exit 0. The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js`: `maxRetries` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, which crashed the link stage.

The 3 warnings still print but are harmless: a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call, an unused export, and a circular import between `graph.js` and `tracker.js`. Build now finishes clean with 0 errors.
